- `[2026-11-04]` **Use lowercase branch names and separate words with hyphens; never use underscores.**
  Gesture: choose a lowercase, hyphen-separated subject name when creating branches across CaseNetwork repositories.
  Why: The existing branch-naming preference already requires lowercase, and hyphens keep multiword names consistent and easy to read.
